analysis_scope: Comprehensive codebase review including runtime errors, Firebase integration, services, components, and architecture

critical_bugs.issue: Missing Firestore methods being called: firestoreService.addDocument(), getDocument(), updateDocument(), getCollection(), getCollectionWhere()
critical_bugs.impact: CRITICAL - Payment service will crash when trying to record purchases, subscriptions, or bookings. All payment operations will fail.
critical_bugs.details: payment-service.js calls methods that are not defined in firestore-service.js. These methods need to be implemented or replaced with existing methods.
critical_bugs.example: await firestoreService.addDocument(`users/${userId}/purchases`, purchaseData); // METHOD DOES NOT EXIST

critical_bugs.impact: CRITICAL - Code review/reply functionality will crash when trying to save replies to reviews
critical_bugs.details: app.js line 1616 calls firestoreService.addReply() but this method is not defined in firestore-service.js
critical_bugs.example: await firestoreService.addReply(course.id, reviewId, reply); // THROWS: firestoreService.addReply is not a function

critical_bugs.issue: Payment service references non-existent backend API endpoints
critical_bugs.impact: CRITICAL - All payment processing will fail. Stripe integration incomplete.
critical_bugs.details: Calls to /api/create-checkout-session, /api/verify-payment, /api/create-subscription-checkout, /api/verify-subscription will get 404 errors. Backend implementation is missing.
critical_bugs.example: const response = await fetch('/api/create-checkout-session', ...); // 404 NOT FOUND

critical_bugs.issue: Reference to undefined variable 'coursesData' in getAdminStats() method
critical_bugs.impact: HIGH - Admin dashboard statistics will crash when loaded
critical_bugs.details: getAdminStats() references 'coursesData' which is not defined in scope. Should use store.state.courses or pass as parameter.
critical_bugs.example: totalCourses: coursesData ? coursesData.length : null, // ReferenceError: coursesData is not defined

critical_bugs.impact: MEDIUM - Live preview may not work properly in code challenges
critical_bugs.details: updatePreview is a named export from code-editor.js but imported as if it's a direct export. Should work but inconsistent pattern.
critical_bugs.solution: Verify import path and ensure function is properly exported

warnings.details: storage.hydrateFromCloud() is marked deprecated in favor of appHydrationService. Should use appHydrationService.hydrateAppState() instead.
warnings.solution: Replace calls to storage.hydrateFromCloud() with appHydrationService.hydrateAppState(uid)

warnings.issue: Firebase credentials loaded from environment variables - will be null if not configured
warnings.details: If VITE_FIREBASE_* environment variables are not set, entire Firebase functionality silently disabled. Could leave users thinking app works when it doesn't.
warnings.solution: Add console warnings or user-facing notification when Firebase is not configured

warnings.issue: Async initialization without error handling in constructor
warnings.details: _init() is async but called from constructor without await. CodeMirror may not be ready when needed.
warnings.solution: Implement promise-based ready state or callback mechanism

warnings.issue: Multiple parallel Firestore calls could hit quota limits
warnings.details: syncReviewsInBackground() fetches reviews for 15 courses in parallel without request batching. Could exceed Firestore limits.
warnings.solution: Implement request batching or sequential loading with delays

warnings.issue: No error logging for failed Firestore sync operations
warnings.details: Failed sync operations are silently ignored. User progress could be lost without notification.
warnings.solution: Add console.warn() or error tracking for sync failures

warnings.issue: Calling storage.addReply() without checking if method exists
warnings.details: storage.addReply() is called but could fail if not properly initialized
warnings.solution: Verify all storage methods exist before calling

warnings.issue: 7-second timeout for Firebase initialization could cause race conditions
warnings.details: If auth initialization times out, app proceeds in offline mode. Could lead to inconsistent state.
warnings.solution: Implement proper state machine instead of timeout fallback

warnings.details: Variable assigned but never used. Indicates incomplete code.

firebase_issues.impact: Security risk - database accessible without proper permissions
firebase_issues.details: firestore.rules file exists but may not have proper access control. User data and reviews could be accessible to anyone.
firebase_issues.recommendation: Implement strict Firestore rules restricting access to user's own data

firebase_issues.details: firestore.indexes.json exists but may be incomplete. Composite queries on discussions, reviews need indexes.
firebase_issues.recommendation: Add indexes for: discussions(contextId, createdAt), course_reviews(rating, createdAt)

firebase_issues.issue: Missing error handling for permission-denied errors
firebase_issues.details: Multiple services check for permission-denied errors but don't alert user or provide fallback UI.
firebase_issues.recommendation: Show user-friendly error messages when Firebase access denied

firebase_issues.issue: Firestore access patterns could cause quota issues
firebase_issues.impact: App could stop working if quota exceeded
firebase_issues.details: No request batching or throttling implemented. Background sync fetches reviews for 15 courses in parallel.
firebase_issues.recommendation: Implement quota tracking and rate limiting

firebase_issues.issue: Storage bucket not utilized despite being initialized
firebase_issues.details: firebase-config.js initializes storage but media-service.js doesn't use it properly
firebase_issues.recommendation: Implement proper Firebase Storage integration for media uploads

service_layer_issues.issue: Missing method implementations called by payment-service.js
service_layer_issues.recommendation: Implement these generic CRUD methods or refactor payment-service to use existing methods

service_layer_issues.impact: Code review replies fail to save

service_layer_issues.issue: Local auth fallback could create security issues
service_layer_issues.details: When Firebase not configured, passwords stored in localStorage in plaintext via getLocalAuthStore()
service_layer_issues.recommendation: Remove local auth or add encryption for passwords

service_layer_issues.details: getSecureVideoUrl() is placeholder implementation. Actual signing should happen server-side.
service_layer_issues.recommendation: Implement server-side URL signing for secure video access

service_layer_issues.issue: API key loaded from constructor without validation
service_layer_issues.impact: Gemini API requests will fail if key not configured
service_layer_issues.details: No verification that API key is valid before attempting requests
service_layer_issues.recommendation: Add initialization check and user-facing error if API not configured

component_rendering_issues.issue: CodeMirror modules loaded from esm.sh with version mismatches
component_rendering_issues.details: Multiple versions of CodeMirror modules loaded with potential conflicts. No fallback if CDN fails.
component_rendering_issues.recommendation: Use consistent versions and add offline fallback (textarea)

component_rendering_issues.issue: Variable coursesData used before it's guaranteed to exist
component_rendering_issues.details: coursesData.find() called without null check in some contexts
component_rendering_issues.example: const course = coursesData.find(c => c.id === courseId); // Could be undefined

component_rendering_issues.details: Multiple getElementById calls without null checks. Could crash if elements not found.
component_rendering_issues.recommendation: Add null checks: const el = $('#selector'); if (!el) return;

component_rendering_issues.issue: updatePreview iframe injection vulnerable to XSS
component_rendering_issues.details: User code written to iframe.contentDocument without sanitization
component_rendering_issues.recommendation: Use DOMPurify to sanitize HTML before writing to iframe

api_integration_issues.issue: No rate limiting or timeout handling
api_integration_issues.impact: Could hang or fail under load
api_integration_issues.details: RemoteExecutionService calls Piston without request pooling or timeout strategy

api_integration_issues.issue: API key must be configured for AI hints to work
api_integration_issues.impact: Users get generic hints instead of AI-powered ones
api_integration_issues.details: aiService requires VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY to be set
api_integration_issues.recommendation: Add UI notification if API key not configured

api_integration_issues.impact: Users can't upload media if presets not set
api_integration_issues.recommendation: Allow configuration of Cloudinary upload presets via environment
Implement Node.js/Express backend to handle Stripe webhook and session creation

missing_dependencies.purpose: Handle Stripe payments, session management, webhook verification
missing_dependencies.recommendation: Create Node.js/Express server for payment processing

missing_dependencies.impact: Writing to undefined collections will create them but structure unclear

async_await_issues.issue: Async _init() called from constructor without await
async_await_issues.details: CodeMirror initialization is async but not awaited in constructor
async_await_issues.consequence: Methods like getCode() could be called before editor is ready

async_await_issues.details: Multiple promises settled but individual failures not properly logged
async_await_issues.recommendation: Add error tracking for diagnostic purposes

async_await_issues.details: progressSyncService.queueUpdate() called without awaiting, sync could fail silently
async_await_issues.recommendation: Implement proper error tracking for sync failures
Add proper error handling and retry logic

data_flow_issues.details: App tries to sync from both localStorage and Firestore without clear precedence
data_flow_issues.recommendation: Establish clear single source of truth (Firestore first, fallback to localStorage)

data_flow_issues.issue: Store state not properly reset on logout
data_flow_issues.details: store.state persists across logout in some cases
Reviews loaded once on app init, not refreshed when viewing course later
data_flow_issues.recommendation: Implement cache invalidation or real-time listeners

data_flow_issues.impact: MEDIUM - Progress lost if multiple tabs open
data_flow_issues.details: Progress stored locally with debounced sync to Firestore
data_flow_issues.recommendation: Use SharedWorker or BroadcastChannel for cross-tab sync

data_flow_issues.details: No schema validation when reading from Firestore or localStorage
data_flow_issues.recommendation: Implement Zod or similar for schema validation

css_styling_issues.issue: CSS variable --bg-dots-pattern referenced but not defined
css_styling_issues.details: Used in auth pages but not declared in variables.css
css_styling_issues.recommendation: Add --bg-dots-pattern to variables.css with pattern definition

css_styling_issues.details: desktop-only class used but no corresponding mobile-only styles

css_styling_issues.issue: Animation spinner defined but not in CSS
css_styling_issues.details: inline style uses 'spin' animation not defined in any CSS file

css_styling_issues.issue: Missing dark mode color definitions for some components
css_styling_issues.impact: MEDIUM - Some components hard to read in dark mode
css_styling_issues.recommendation: Audit all components for dark mode contrast (WCAG AA minimum)

security_issues.issue: Local authentication stores passwords in plain text
security_issues.details: getLocalAuthStore() stores passwords unencrypted in localStorage when Firebase not available
security_issues.recommendation: Never store passwords locally. Use session tokens instead.

security_issues.issue: Sensitive data stored in localStorage without encryption
security_issues.details: User profile, progress, notes all stored unencrypted
security_issues.recommendation: Use sessionStorage for sensitive data or implement encryption

security_issues.details: User code written directly to iframe without sanitization
security_issues.recommendation: Use DOMPurify before writing to iframe

security_issues.issue: API credentials exposed in frontend code
security_issues.details: Stripe public key and Cloudinary config in frontend (okay), but not proper CSP

security_issues.issue: No CORS validation for API calls
security_issues.details: Cross-origin requests to Piston API not validated

missing_features: Backend API server for payment processing
Backend API for Stripe webhook handling

code_quality_issues.details: Some services use try-catch, others use promise.catch(), some don't handle errors at all
Auth forms, profile updates don't validate input before sending to Firebase

code_quality_issues.recommendation: Extract to named constants in config

code_quality_issues.details: Errors logged to console but no centralized error tracking
Mix of camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase for similar concepts

code_quality_issues.issue: No unit tests for critical services
code_quality_issues.details: Only auth-service.test.js exists, but firestore, payment, storage untested

architecture_issues.impact: Users don't know features are disabled
architecture_issues.details: When Firebase config missing, many features fail silently instead of showing errors
authService, firestoreService could initialize in wrong order causing failures

architecture_issues.issue: Mix of local-first and cloud-first strategies
architecture_issues.details: Some features use localStorage as source of truth, others use Firestore

architecture_issues.issue: No transaction handling for critical operations
architecture_issues.details: Purchase recording, certificate generation not atomic

architecture_issues.impact: Hard to maintain, poor code organization
architecture_issues.details: app.js likely >5000 lines with all route handlers inline
Simple store object used instead of proper state management library

architecture_issues.impact: Hard to test, difficult to use services elsewhere
architecture_issues.details: Services call showToast(), manipulate DOM directly

optimization_opportunities.recommendation: Split route handlers into separate files, lazy load components

optimization_opportunities.issue: Data loaded all at once on app init
optimization_opportunities.recommendation: Implement pagination and lazy loading for courses/lessons
Implement caching layer with stale-while-revalidate pattern
Use Cloudinary transformations for responsive images
Implement batch operations for bulk reads

optimization_opportunities.issue: No WebP image format support detection
